## project/.claude/plugins/aidd-telemetry/hooks/hooks.json
{
  "hooks": {
    "SessionStart": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/task.cjs remind",
            "statusMessage": "AIDD Telemetry: remind the task",
            "timeout": 5
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ledger.cjs ingest",
            "statusMessage": "AIDD Telemetry: update the measurement ledger",
            "timeout": 5
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
